description: This Java class provides utility methods for handling web application configurations in the OFBiz framework. It manages tasks such as parsing web.xml files, retrieving servlet paths, initializing dispatchers, and accessing security and delegator components.

classes.name: WebAppUtil
classes.description: Utility class providing methods for managing web application configurations, dispatchers, security, and related components within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: getControlServletPath
methods.description: Retrieves the control servlet path based on web.xml definitions for a given WebappInfo.

methods.name: isDistributable
methods.description: Checks if the web application is marked as distributable in web.xml.

methods.name: getWebappInfoFromWebsiteId
methods.description: Retrieves WebappInfo for a given website ID.

methods.name: getWebSiteId
methods.description: Extracts the web site ID from web.xml for a given WebappInfo.

methods.name: getDispatcher
methods.description: Retrieves or creates the LocalDispatcher instance associated with the ServletContext.

methods.name: setAttributesFromRequestBody
methods.description: Reads the request body (e.g., JSON) and sets parameters as request attributes.

methods.name: makeWebappDispatcher
methods.description: Creates a LocalDispatcher for the webapp using the provided ServletContext and Delegator.

methods.name: getDelegator
methods.description: Retrieves the Delegator instance from the ServletContext, or creates one if absent.

methods.name: getSecurity
methods.description: Retrieves or initializes the Security object from the ServletContext.

methods.name: getWebXml
methods.description: Loads and parses the web.xml configuration into a WebXml object.

methods.name: parseWebXmlFile
methods.description: Parses a web.xml file into a WebXml object, utilizing caching.
